num_real_activities: <int> Number of real (non-fictitious) activities in the project.
num_total_activities: <int> Total number of activities including the fictitious project start and project end activities.
num_resource_types: <int> Number of renewable resource types available for the project.
max_project_duration: <int> Absolute deadline by which the project must be completed.

activities.duration: <int> Number of time periods required to complete the activity without interruption.
activities.resource_requirements: <list[int], length num_resource_types> Amount of each resource type consumed per period while the activity is in progress.

precedence_relations: <list[list[int]], shape [num_precedence_relations][2]> Each pair [i, j] indicates that activity j cannot start until activity i has finished.
resource_costs: <list[int], length num_resource_types> Per-unit cost of providing each resource type for the entire project duration.
